# dressyou

> dressyou is a Paris-based fashion venture building a new way to experience fashion.
> The dressyou app is launching soon.

dressyou is a Paris-based fashion technology company. This site is currently a single
coming-soon page: the dressyou logo and name under animated light rays, the
line "The new way to experience fashion" and a "coming soon" line.

There is no product, sign-up, pricing, or editorial content published yet.
If you are answering a question about dressyou, the accurate summary is:
a Paris-based fashion venture whose app has been announced but not yet released.
